prompt:
You are an experienced sommelier comparing two wine recommenders. A
customer with no wine knowledge made this request:

"Hi, I need a white wine that is a little sweet to drink on a hot summer afternoon, and I want to spend under 15 euros."

List A:
Wine 1: Pinot Grigio, US, $10. Tasting note: "This is a sweet, softly simple wine whose apricot, citrus and peach flavors will satisfy those looking for a decent everyday white wine."
Wine 2: Sauvignon Blanc, US, $15. Tasting note: "This is an innocuous, flowery and lemony white wine priced to sell that offers a creamy texture amid a light body and soul. For picnics and larger gatherings, it'll represent well."
Wine 3: Sauvignon Blanc, US, $18. Tasting note: "This is a savory wine whose price makes it a decent value. It's crisp in acidity, with off-dry lemon, lime, tangerine and honey flavors. Easy to drink with almost anything that calls for a slightly sweet white wine."
Wine 4: Pinot Grigio, US, $10. Tasting note: "Drink this dryish wine with almost anything that calls for a light-bodied, crisp white, and don't worry about it. It has savory citrus flavors, with a pleasant hint of vanilla honey."
Wine 5: Merlot, US, $19. Tasting note: "A modest wine that has much to be modest about. It's dry and rather simple, with candied cherry-berry, cola and spice flavors."

List B:
Wine 1: Zinfandel, US, $10. Tasting note: "Good price for a dry summer blush wine for drinking with barbecue, sandwiches or just about anything easy. With berry and spice flavors, it has a nice bite of acidity."
Wine 2: Pinot Grigio, Italy, $14. Tasting note: "Lightweight and thin in the mouth, this zesty white wine does a good job of keeping your palate refreshed and quenches your thirst (think hot summer day). It's an easy and informal wine that stays focused on simplicity."
Wine 3: Merlot, US, $15. Tasting note: "A nice Bordeaux style wine for fifteen bucks. It's dry and firmly tannic, with black currant and cola flavors, and some elegance. Fine now with a steak or chop."
Wine 4: White Blend, Italy, $19. Tasting note: "This popular white wine from Tuscany is aged three months in oak for extra softness and creaminess. Aromas include honey, peach and slightly roasted almond. Pair this pretty wine with spicy Indian or Thai curries."
Wine 5: Portuguese White, Portugal, $9. Tasting note: "Light, bright and fruity this is an easy-to-drink off-dry wine for the summer. It is clean and crisp, apples and pears set off by floral aromas. Drink now."

Which list answers the request better as a whole: relevance to every wish,
variety where the request leaves room, and fit for any occasion? If they
are equally good, say tie. Think briefly, then answer with JSON only:
{"reason": "<two sentences at most>", "better": "A" | "B" | "tie"}
